title: Bulk article processing hides per-article failures as success
reasoning: fetchAndProcessArticles(from:) is async throws, and processArticle has meaningful errors such as missing AI configuration and content that is too short. The task group converts every thrown error to nil, so a feed can fail entirely and still return [] as a successful result. That makes configuration and extraction failures indistinguishable from a feed with no usable articles.
reproduction: Call fetchAndProcessArticles(from:) for a briefing-mode feed while aiService is nil. processArticle throws aiServiceUnavailable, but the bulk method returns an empty array without throwing.
recommendation: Decide the intended failure policy explicitly. If feed processing should fail on infrastructure/configuration errors, remove try? and propagate errors. If individual article filtering is intended, catch only expected filter errors and surface or log unexpected failures.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise ArticleRepository failure paths or distinguish filtered articles from processing failures.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests proving briefing mode without an AI service throws from fetchAndProcessArticles(from:), or, if partial success is intended, that only documented filter errors are skipped while unexpected errors are reported.
